sentences.text: Megapodius rokusi was a large megapode, with an estimated body mass of about 3.9 kg.
It is known from the Late Pleistocene deposits of Liang Bua on the island of Flores in Indonesia.
The species was named Megapodius rokusi.
It represents a newly described taxon.
The formal description was authored by Meijer and colleagues.
The study introduced a new megapode species from the Pleistocene of Liang Bua, Flores.
Results were published in the journal Alcheringa: An Australasian Journal of Palaeontology.
The authors of the paper are Hanneke J. M. Meijer, Thomas Sutikna, E. Wahyu Saptomo, and Matthew W. Tocheri.
Fossil material was recovered in Indonesia.
Megapodius belongs to the family Megapodiidae.
The genus is placed within the class Reptilia.
Its fossil range is confined to the Late Pleistocene.
